about: Ready-made tours. Each stop is a gallery (as numbered on the map) with the works to look for there (MFA object ids from artworks.json). Edit freely; the app reads this file.

tours.title: Impressionism in 30 minutes
tours.subtitle: Monet, Pissarro, Sisley, Van Gogh, Gauguin
tours.description: From Monet's series paintings to the Post-Impressionists, in three neighbouring galleries on Level 2.

stops.note: Monet painted the same motif again and again to catch changing light: a grainstack in snow, Rouen Cathedral's façade.
Painting outdoors around Paris: Pissarro's roads, Sisley's snow, Renoir in Venice.
After Impressionism: Van Gogh's Roulin portraits, Cézanne, Degas and Gauguin's largest painting.

tours.title: Van Gogh on two floors
tours.subtitle: Early Holland to the last summer in Auvers
tours.description: Start with his dark early Weaver on Level 1, then climb to the colour of Arles, Saint-Rémy and Auvers.

stops.note: Weaver (1884): painted in Nuenen, years before he moved to France.
Gauguin's Brittany, the year after he and Van Gogh shared a house in Arles.
The Roulin family portraits, Ravine, the ploughman's field and Houses at Auvers.

tours.title: Old Masters: Velázquez to Turner
tours.subtitle: Spain, Flanders, Holland, England
tours.description: Four centuries of European painting around the grand staircase on Level 2.

stops.note: Velázquez and El Greco: Spanish court portraiture.
Rubens in Flemish and Dutch company.
A small early Rembrandt: the artist standing back from his easel.
Turner's Slave Ship, Millet's Sower and Manet's Execution of Maximilian.
